attributes.action: No Child Left Behind – Mental Health Support for Autism, ADHD & PDA
attributes.additional_details: This petition calls for better, earlier mental health support for children with autism, ADHD and PDA. Even children as young as eight can experience severe anxiety, emotional distress and self-harm. Too many families face long waits while children struggle, sometimes becoming unable to attend school. We want specialist assessments, better understanding of neurodivergence and joined-up support, so no child has to reach crisis point before receiving the help they desperately need.
attributes.background: Children as young as eight can experience severe mental health difficulties, anxiety and self-harm. Autism, ADHD and PDA must be understood. No child should be considered too young for help, forced out of education by unmet needs or left to reach crisis point before someone listens.

rejection.details:
We understand you would like better and earlier mental health support for children with autism, ADHD and PDA, including specialist assessments and more joined-up support. However, we're not sure exactly what changes you want the Government to make to achieve this.

You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Increase funding and review children’s mental health system
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775284

Create a legal right to ADHD or Autism assessment within 3 months
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781858

Fund the creation of specialist autistic and PDA schools
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781740
